This card is a [[Intel PRO/Wireless 5000 LAN 3A Mini PCI Adapter]] (WM3A5000) on a Mini PCI -> PCI adapter. :The same Mini PCI -> PCI adapter appears to be used for the [[Intel PRO/Wireless 2011B LAN PCI Adapter]].
This card has a reverse threaded RP-SMA connector.
The OUI used by this device is presumed to the standard [[Xircom]] ID :used by other early [[Intel]] devices of this era (00:05:3C).
